newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ADB sets $50 mln guarantee for Sri Lankan bank.
newsitem.headline: ADB sets $50 mln guarantee for Sri Lankan bank.

text.p: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) said on Thursday its board had approved a $50 million guarantee package and a $5 million direct loan to the National Development Bank of Sri Lanka (NDBSL).
The guarantee and loan package is aimed at helping some 5,000 entrepreneurs in Sri Lanka expand their businesses.

"With the guarantee, NDBSL was able to obtain a 10-year fixed-rate syndicated loan from the international loan market at a maturity and pricing that are currently unavailable to the borrower," the Manila-based multilateral bank said in a statement.
The syndicated loan will be arranged by the Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd and Nippon Life Insurance Inc.
The 10-year direct loan will be re-lent to a dozen local credit institutions, which in turn will extend loan packages to entrepreneurs.
